sections.label: Question Time income report
sections.summary: A Member says he quoted a December 2023 Zero One report on incomes during Question Time, and notes a procedure is incomplete.

sentences.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
sentences.text: During yesterday's Question Time, I quoted a December 2023 Zero One report, which stated that incomes reported —

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: I believe the procedure has not been completed.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: The Member may wish to take a seat for the procedure to move the Adjournment Motion to begin.

sections.label: Explanation at next Sitting
sections.summary: An explanation can be issued subsequently or at the next Sitting.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: You can issue an explanation subsequently or you can do it at the next Sitting.
